rides.name: Drop Line®
rides.description: Drop Line lifts guests more than 20 stories above Dollywood's Timber Canyon. The ride's gondola slowly spins around the tower as it ascends, providing guests with a bird's eye view of the Great Smoky Mountains. In an instant, Drop Line plummets them back to the ground in a thrilling rush of excitement.

rides.name: Lumberjack Lifts
rides.description: Two 30-foot-tall towers await passengers who can "pull" the ropes, lifting the cars as high as 25 feet in the air. Or, if you dare, release the cable for an exciting but "kid friendly" free fall!

rides.name: Mystery Mine®
rides.description: What if there is no light at the end of the tunnel? Find out on Dollywood's Mystery Mine® steel coaster where a 1,811-foot track travels through an abandoned coal mine. A hair-raising 95-degree, 85-foot vertical drop plunges into darkness!

rides.name: Thunderhead®
rides.description: Carefully situated between two mountains, this massive wooden coaster stands tall among the mighty trees and takes advantage of the area's rough and tumble terrain to create a daring ride featuring a 100-foot drop and a top speed of 55 mph.

rides.name: Whistle Punk Chaser®
rides.description: Whistle Punk Chaser, a junior coaster, throws thrilling twists and turns at Dollywood's younger loggers, helping prepare them for the day they can join their parents aboard the award-winning Thunderhead wooden coaster.

rides.name: FireChaser Express®
rides.description: It's FireChaser Express — the nation's first dual-launch family coaster — blasting riders forward and backward! Celebrating the heroic spirit of Smoky Mountain firefighters, this forward-and-backward-launching family coaster features a 72-foot lift height and reaches a speed of 35 mph.

rides.name: Firehouse Fun Yard
rides.description: Recruits less than 39 inches can enjoy their time at the FireChaser Express Firehouse Fun Yard. This interactive children's play area includes pop-jet water features, a "soft play" structure where children can slide and play, a block table, and a chalk board coloring wall.

rides.name: Wild Eagle®
rides.description: America's first wing coaster, the first ride of its kind in the U.S., perched 21 stories above Dollywood. Wild Eagle® seats riders on either side of the track so there is nothing but air above and below the rider — as if they are actually soaring high above the Smoky Mountains.

rides.name: Blazing Fury
rides.description: An out-of-control fire is just minutes away from engulfing this 1880s town, and chaos ensues as the town's residents hurry to escape the blaze. Riders scream through town on this indoor roller coaster, taking each hill and curve with great speed as they try to outrun the fire.

rides.name: Calico Falls Schoolhouse
rides.description: The one-room schoolhouse offers visitors a view of how many schools appeared in East Tennessee during the 1890s. It clearly reminds us all of a simpler time when slate boards took the place of pen and paper. You can easily imagine students eager to learn about the ever-changing world outside the mountains of East Tennessee.

rides.name: Daredevil Falls
rides.description: Only a real daredevil will venture into an abandoned logging camp for a one-of-a-kind boat expedition. Just when you catch your breath, your boat careens over a waterfall down a 60-foot drop at a heart-racing 50 mph! This super flume water ride consists of quick turns and a 60-foot drop with the boat holding eight guests.

rides.name: Robert F. Thomas Chapel
rides.description: Step inside this one-room country church where the simple wooden pews and hardwood floors echo with the sounds of families and neighbors gathering for Sunday morning worship. Named in honor of the doctor who delivered little Dolly Rebecca Parton.

rides.name: Tennessee Tornado
rides.description: What happens when a mighty twister sweeps through an old Tennessee Mining Company? This triple spiral-looping coaster makes you feel like you've landed inside a funnel cloud as you zoom down a 128-foot drop through an actual mountain at speeds nearing 70 mph.

rides.name: Wings of America Show Birds
rides.description: The Wings of America show is a fascinating and educational experience for audiences. Many of the beautiful raptors presented in the show live next door to the theatre. Each individual bird's story is showcased so you can learn more about some of Dollywood's most popular entertainers.

rides.name: Barnstormer
rides.description: Enjoy the same breathtaking moments that daring stunt pilots of the 1920s might have experienced as they zoomed over the fields of nearby farms. The Barnstormer features two pendulum arms with seating for 32 riders. Seated back to back, riders travel progressively higher on each swing, reaching a maximum speed of 45 mph and 230 degrees of rotation. At its peak, the Barnstormer reaches a staggering 81 feet in the air!

rides.name: Granny's Garden
rides.description: The kids will enjoy digging up tons of fun at Granny's Garden. This interactive playground experience will keep the kids laughing for hours with its soft-play structures where children can climb, slide and play.

rides.name: Lil' Pilots Playground
rides.description: Down on the ground, Lil' Pilots Playground entertains pilots in training. Little ones 48 inches and under can explore a 22-foot by 16-foot wooden bi-plane, play with a one-of-a-kind drum set and climb and slide amid a variety of structures.

rides.name: Imagination Playhouse
rides.description: A whimsical play area where imagination runs wild, perfect for young explorers visiting The Village.

rides.name: Dollywood Express Train Depot
rides.description: The engineer sounds the whistle and your 20-minute mountain excursion is underway. Our authentic 110-ton steam locomotive engine takes you on a breathtaking five-mile journey through the foothills of the Great Smoky Mountains where you'll enjoy pastoral scenery and some of the most beautiful views that nature has to offer.

rides.name: Village Carousel
rides.description: Dollywood's carousel features 60 beautifully painted animals, including the lead horse lovingly referred to as "Dolly" because of its flowing blonde mane. Calliope music fills the air and creates a fun-filled setting where smiles abound as the carousel spins.

rides.name: Busy Bees
rides.description: Our "busy bees" are all abuzz with fun and excitement! Ride along as the "bumble bee" cars fly 'round and 'round. It's a ride that promises to "busy" the entire family with lots of fun.

rides.name: Country Fair Splash and Play
rides.description: Cool off and splash around at Country Fair Splash and Play, a water play area perfect for the whole family.

rides.name: Demolition Derby
rides.description: Family and friends may cross your path, but this is one time that it's okay to bump them out of your way as you make your way through the skirmish of cluttered bumper cars. It's guaranteed good times for the whole family as you make your way through the chaos!

rides.name: Lemon Twist
rides.description: Once you spot the giant lemonade pitcher, you know you're not far from the Lemon Twist. Nine spinning "lemon cups" revolve around the pitcher in the center — the perfect ride for little ones who are thirsty for adventure.

rides.name: Lucky Ducky
rides.description: Everyone's a winner on our Lucky Ducky ride where all the cute "duck" cars travel in a circle of fun. These lucky ducks are sure to entertain the entire family.

rides.name: Piggy Parade
rides.description: Your little one will love this parade! A larger-than-life scarecrow keeps a watchful eye on the Piggy Parade as the adorable "piggy" cars travel in a circle of fun.

rides.name: Shooting Star
rides.description: Let your legs dangle as the car slowly makes its way to the top of the Shooting Star kids' drop tower. Just when you think you've made it to the top, the Shooting Star begins a daring-but-not-scary descent back to ground level.

rides.name: Sky Rider
rides.description: On the Sky Rider, you're the pilot as the plane soars 70 feet above Country Fair. There's even room for a co-pilot and either can control the rudders to move the wings on this exciting ride.

rides.name: The Amazing Flying Elephants
rides.description: Take a seat aboard one of the "elephant" cars and hold on as you soar 'round and 'round and up and down as these "elephants" take you on an amazing adventure. These lucky ducks are sure to entertain the entire family.

rides.name: The Scrambler
rides.description: You'll definitely twist and shout, and you'll probably laugh and scream even more as our scrambler ride shuffles you around in every direction. Things definitely look a little "scrambled" as you move back and forth.

rides.name: The Waltzing Swinger
rides.description: Dollywood's Waltzing Swinger soars to new heights of adventure as you glide through the air, 25 feet above Country Fair. There's nothing like the swings to bring out the kid in everyone.

rides.name: Dolly's Tennessee Mountain Home
rides.description: You'll get a true feeling of what Dolly means when she speaks of her Tennessee Mountain Home upbringing as you visit this two-room replica of her Locust Ridge childhood home. Though it lacked electricity and running water, love was abundant in this tiny little mountain house that Dolly and her family called home.

rides.name: Smoky Mountain River Rampage
rides.description: Dollywood's Smoky Mountain River Rampage is a white water rafting adventure full of exciting dips, twists and turns along the way. No two excursions are the same, but each one promises a good soaking for all who dare to brave the rapids.

rides.name: Lightning Rod®
rides.description: Themed after a tricked-out 1950s-era hot rod, Lightning Rod® sends riders more than 20 stories up its lift hill. Lightning Rod races down the 165-foot drop and propels guests along its 3,800-foot track with nearly 20 seconds of airtime. USA Today readers have consistently named it one of the top-10 best roller coasters in the country.

rides.name: Rockin' Roadway
rides.description: If you've ever dreamed of taking the wheel of a classic Corvette, Thunderbird or Cadillac, here's your chance. You'll soak up the sunshine as you drive along this scenic route down a country road set in the 1950s where classic Berma Shave billboards dot the landscape.

rides.name: Behind the Seams
rides.description: A walk-through exhibit showcasing Dolly Parton's iconic wardrobe and signature style through the years — part of The Dolly Parton Experience.

rides.name: Dolly's Home on Wheels
rides.description: Visit the custom tour bus that carried Dolly Parton across the country during her legendary music career — part of The Dolly Parton Experience.

rides.name: Precious Memories
rides.description: An exhibit celebrating the most important relationships and memories of Dolly Parton's life — part of The Dolly Parton Experience.

rides.name: Songteller
rides.description: An immersive exhibit exploring the stories behind Dolly Parton's most beloved songs, told in her own words — part of The Dolly Parton Experience.

rides.name: Big Bear Mountain®
rides.description: Big Bear Mountain® is the longest coaster at Dollywood, taking guests of all ages on an unforgettable family-friendly expedition in search of the Big Bear. Circling Wildwood Grove for nearly two minutes on 3,990 ft. of track, this gigantic coaster features onboard audio, including music and announcements from Ned Oakley himself. This triple-launching family coaster features a 66-foot maximum track height and reaches a speed of 48 mph.

rides.name: Black Bear Trail
rides.description: In Wildwood Grove, even the bears are friendly and fun-loving. Climbing onto the back of one of the friendly bears, riders glide through the beautiful backwoods, enjoying the scenery, accompanied by a joyful tune. There are plenty of surprises as you meander through the woods on the Black Bear Trail, making unexpected discoveries along the way.

rides.name: Dragonflier
rides.description: One of the most playful creatures inhabiting Wildwood Grove's creekside, Dragonflier mimics the flight of a Smoky Mountain dragonfly as it speeds through the terrain in a twisting, unpredictable path. With the rush of wind and the thrill of flight, there's nothing more exhilarating than a ride on the wings of a dragonfly! This suspended family coaster reaches speeds up to 43 mph with a lift height of 63 feet.

rides.name: Frogs & Fireflies
rides.description: Hungry frogs chase each other through the marsh in this playful roundabout ride. A clump of tall grasses in the center is home to flickering fireflies, fluttering just out of reach of the frogs. Racing around and around to the sounds of a lively bluegrass tune, riders dodge up and down as they try to catch the fireflies.

rides.name: Great Tree Swing
rides.description: The Great Tree Swing, wound with vines and decorated with bright leaves, is a breathtaking thrill as riders fly high through the skies. Riders experience heights of up to 40 feet as the ride vehicle swings forward and backward in a pendulum motion.

rides.name: Hidden Hollow
rides.description: Near the Wildwood Tree, a secret play area named Hidden Hollow beckons families with a collection of kid-friendly activities for hours of play. Surrounded by a forest scene, kids of all ages get in touch with nature, climbing up tree trunk net towers, exploring tree crawls, traversing a series of blocks, and sliding down hollow logs.

rides.name: NightFlight Expedition
rides.description: Welcome to NightFlight Expedition — a groundbreaking new addition to Dollywood that redefines adventure! Prepare to embark on an immersive indoor adventure coaster like no other, combining storytelling, thrills, and cutting-edge technology in a way only Dollywood can deliver. This first ride of its kind in the world invites guests of all ages to soar over the Smoky Mountains, plunge through dramatic rapids, climb rugged ridges, and glide across shimmering bioluminescent waters — all in one unforgettable journey.

rides.name: The Mad Mockingbird
rides.description: On any given day, a colorful variety of birds dart around Wildwood Grove. The Mad Mockingbird takes riders on a whimsical flight as they dip and soar in an aerial ballet.

rides.name: The Wildwood Tree
rides.description: Beyond an ancient hollow log and into a hidden land, Wildwood Grove beckons the explorer in all of us. Let curiosity be your guide as you journey ever deeper, past sparkling creeks, through a charming village, and under the mighty limbs of the great Wildwood Tree.

rides.name: Treetop Tower
rides.description: Inspired by the nutritious acorns of Wildwood Grove, the whimsical Treetop Tower whirls riders through the air in charming hand-carved acorns, which offer panoramic views of the beautiful Wildwood Tree before gently falling to the forest floor.

rides.name: Wildwood Creek
rides.description: At the heart of the Grove, Wildwood Creek is a welcome oasis for cooling off. Crossing over a scenic footbridge, young and old can wade and splash the day away in fresh mountain water. Charming musical instruments — chimes, drums and a xylophone — invite guests to create their own tunes.

entertainment.name: DP's Celebrity Theater
entertainment.description: Dollywood's premier performance venue showcasing top-tier entertainment acts throughout the season.

entertainment.name: Great Pumpkin LumiNights Character Meet & Greet
entertainment.description: Fall fun and memories can be found around every corner during Dollywood's Harvest Festival. Strike your best pumpkin pose and capture a perfect photo with captivating autumn characters including Harvey!

entertainment.name: Showstreet Palace Theater
entertainment.description: A beloved Dollywood venue hosting classic and beloved musical performances on Showstreet.

entertainment.name: The Kingdom Heirs
entertainment.description: Dollywood's own award-winning Southern gospel group performs its biggest hits from more than 30 years of chart-toppers.

entertainment.name: Lumberjack Jam Band
entertainment.description: Live bluegrass and folk music performances in the heart of Timber Canyon, celebrating the musical traditions of the Smoky Mountains.

entertainment.name: Valley Theater
entertainment.description: Nestled in Craftsman's Valley, this charming theater hosts some of Dollywood's most beloved seasonal shows.

entertainment.name: Forever Country
entertainment.description: Seven talented performers celebrate the "Prime" country of the 80s and 90s with traditional roots and new sounds!

entertainment.name: Wings of America Birds of Prey
entertainment.description: Get an up-close look and learn some fascinating facts about these amazing birds of prey, including America's most iconic symbol of freedom. All birds of prey at Dollywood are under the care of the American Eagle Foundation.

entertainment.name: Back Porch Theater
entertainment.description: A cozy outdoor amphitheater in Rivertown Junction hosting live music and entertainment throughout the day.

entertainment.name: Good Vibes
entertainment.description: This incredible production showcases the talent of four vocalists and a five-piece band. A curated selection of songs from various genres — including country, contemporary Christian and pop — create an uplifting and positive message you are sure to be inspired by.

entertainment.name: Pines Theater
entertainment.description: Jukebox Junction's entertainment hub, hosting live shows in a classic 1950s-inspired setting.

entertainment.name: Dreamsong Theater
entertainment.description: The centerpiece of The Dolly Parton Experience, Dreamsong Theater hosts immersive film and live performances celebrating Dolly's music and legacy.

entertainment.name: Heartsong
entertainment.description: In this multi-sensory film experience, Dolly Parton takes you on a breathtaking journey through the Great Smoky Mountains.

entertainment.name: Heidi Parton's Kin & Friends
entertainment.description: Join Dolly's niece Heidi Parton as she and her family and friends perform hit songs across a variety of genres and celebrate the Parton family gift of music.

entertainment.name: The Dolly Parton Experience
entertainment.description: The Dolly Parton Experience features interactive exhibits spanning Dolly's iconic career, the inspiration for her biggest dreams, the importance of her family, and a curated exhibit highlighting Dolly's signature style through the years. Three times the size of the former Chasing Rainbows Museum, it provides guests more Dolly than ever.

entertainment.name: LumiNights Dance Party
entertainment.description: A brand-new dance party experience joins the fun and glow of Great Pumpkin LumiNights each autumn evening. The colorful night full of twinkling lights and a plethora of pumpkins is joined by a playlist to get toes tapping and dancing in the crisp air.

entertainment.name: Smoky Mountain String Band
entertainment.description: Join our talented musicians for some of the best bluegrass music you'll find anywhere. You're sure to leave with a smile on your face and a song in your heart!

entertainment.name: Wildwood Grove Characters Meet & Greet
entertainment.description: Wildwood Grove is home to a friendly ensemble of woodland creatures. Flit, Flutter, and Benjamin Bear delight in welcoming families to play and enjoy the grove. At select times, meet and take photos with our friendly inhabitants just steps from the mighty Wildwood Tree.

dining.name: Front Porch Café
dining.description: This family restaurant features many of Dolly's favorite meals. We can also accommodate a meal for any food allergy — just ask for one of our chefs.

dining.name: Showstreet Frozen Lemonade
dining.description: At Showstreet Frozen Lemonade, you'll find one of our guests' favorite treats. Try classic frozen lemonade or other refreshing flavors. Also a convenient place to pick up a refillable mug when entering the park.

dining.name: Showstreet Ice Cream
dining.description: Stop by for a frozen and delicious treat to satisfy your sweet tooth! Choose from hand-scooped Mayfield® ice cream served in cones or sundaes with yummy toppings, or pick a creamy milkshake in your favorite flavor.

dining.name: Showstreet Snacks
dining.description: Fuel up for a fun-filled Dollywood day by choosing from a variety of tasty snacks, including Nutty Bavarian treats, a giant pickle, butterfly pretzels, cotton candy, popcorn and refreshing beverages.

dining.name: Spotlight Bakery
dining.description: Our pastry chefs create tempting treats to satisfy any sweet tooth — from cookies, cupcakes and brownies to a 25-pound apple pie baked to perfection in a cast-iron skillet.

dining.name: Drop Line Dippin' Dots
dining.description: Dippin' Dots flash-frozen ice cream served near the Drop Line attraction in Timber Canyon. Try cookies n' cream, rainbow ice, or the seasonal festival flavor.

dining.name: Lumber Jack's Pizza
dining.description: As any lumberjack can tell you, it's easy to work up a big appetite whether you're having fun or working hard! Enjoy a variety of pizzas, salads, snacks and drinks to fuel up for a great Dollywood day.

dining.name: SkyView Snacks
dining.description: Don't let your hunger soar atop Wilderness Pass — stop into SkyView Snacks for the perfect treat without ever leaving Wild Eagle Plaza. Made-fresh Dollywood favorites like a giant pickle, butterfly pretzels, cotton candy, popcorn and an ICEE®.

dining.name: Splinter's Funnel Cakes
dining.description: Splinter's Funnel Cakes serves up fantastic deep-fried favorites including the butterfly funnel cake, berries & cream funnel cake, and cinnamon bread served in mini form! Customize with toppings including strawberry pie filling, apple pie filling, whipped cream, crumbled Oreos or hot fudge.

dining.name: The Dog House
dining.description: Quick-serve hot dogs and classic park snacks located in the heart of Wilderness Pass.

dining.name: Trailhead Eats
dining.description: Pick up your mobile order of delicious menu choices at Trailhead Eats, also featuring seasonal options that rotate throughout the year.

dining.name: Wilderness Pass Restaurant
dining.description: Nestled in the natural beauty of the Great Smoky Mountains, this is an ideal place to eat, relax and recharge. Guests enjoy rotisserie, smoked and wood-fired meats and a variety of menu choices inspired by Appalachian culture and cuisine.

dining.name: Granny Ogle's Ham 'n' Beans
dining.description: Nothing says you've stepped into the south like a plate of ham and pinto beans with great Southern hospitality. At Granny Ogle's Ham 'n' Beans, you can expect a heaping helping of both!

dining.name: Cinnamon Bread at The Grist Mill
dining.description: Built in 1982, the Dollywood Grist Mill was the first fully operational grist mill built in Tennessee in more than 100 years. Today, it's home to world-famous cinnamon bread, freshly made daily before your very eyes. Try it with buttercream icing or Dollywood's own apple butter.

dining.name: Hickory House BBQ
dining.description: In the South, we take our barbeque seriously. Grab a table and taste our award-winning BBQ recipes and other smokehouse favorites.

dining.name: Miss Lillian's BBQ Corner
dining.description: Miss Lillian loves to have you sit a spell, but she's selected a few favorite BBQ dishes and made them readily available for guests on the go.

dining.name: Miss Lillian's Mill House
dining.description: Miss Lillian, one of Dollywood's most colorful characters, invites you to join her for some of the best home cooking you'll find in the Smokies.

dining.name: Pork Rinds
dining.description: Don't miss these fresh pork rinds, deep-fried to golden perfection for a one-of-a-kind Southern snack. Enjoy plain or add extra flavor including BBQ, Tennessee hot or salt & vinegar.

dining.name: Tennessee Tornado Dippin' Dots
dining.description: Dippin' Dots flash-frozen ice cream served near the Tennessee Tornado coaster in Craftsman's Valley. Try cookies n' cream, rainbow ice, or the seasonal festival flavor.

dining.name: Iron Horse Pizza
dining.description: Stop by this conveniently-located eatery just steps from the namesake Dollywood Express. Enjoy a variety of flatbread pizzas, salads, snacks and drinks.

dining.name: PaPaw's Roadside Market
dining.description: Stop in for a quick and refreshing snack as you make your way to or from The Village. Try a giant pickle, butterfly pretzel, cotton candy, popcorn or a refreshing beverage.

dining.name: Village Lemonade
dining.description: Refreshing hand-squeezed and frozen lemonade served in The Village — a perfect cool-down treat.

dining.name: Blue Ribbon Cones
dining.description: Cool down your play day with an old fashioned float, soft churned ice cream, chocolate dipped cones or seasonal specialty cones. Also featuring drinks and other snacks, Blue Ribbon Cones provides families a place to grab a bite without leaving the fun fair atmosphere.

dining.name: Blue Ribbon Picnic Pavilion
dining.description: An outdoor picnic pavilion in Country Fair, perfect for families to sit down and enjoy a meal in the heart of the midway.

dining.name: Celebration Hall
dining.description: Celebration Hall is our cozy, indoor picnic pavilion — perfect for groups, special events, dining buffets, and hearty helpings of Southern hospitality.

dining.name: Country Fair Dippin' Dots
dining.description: Dippin' Dots flash-frozen ice cream in Country Fair. Try cookies n' cream, rainbow ice, Big Bear brownie batter, or the seasonal festival flavor.

dining.name: Grandstand Café
dining.description: It's the perfect pit stop during a trip through the midway in Country Fair. Reminiscent of the concession stands at the local fair, Grandstand Café serves up award-winning food deserving of a blue ribbon.

dining.name: Midway Market
dining.description: What better way to reminisce about great times on the Midway than with a tasty snack? Try a giant pickle, butterfly pretzel, cotton candy, popcorn or a refreshing beverage.

dining.name: Aunt Granny's Restaurant
dining.description: Named by USA Today as one of the top 10 best theme park restaurants in the country, Aunt Granny puts out a grand spread served family-style with something for everyone.

dining.name: Country Cookers - Kettle Korn
dining.description: A Dollywood favorite, this sweet and salty popcorn is prepared fresh daily and offers an interesting demonstration as the corn is popped on the spot!

dining.name: Crossroads Funnel Cakes
dining.description: One of our most popular food items, funnel cakes are just plain fun to eat! Crossroads Funnel Cakes serves up deep-fried favorites including the butterfly funnel cake, customizable with toppings like strawberry pie filling, whipped cream, crumbled Oreos or hot fudge.

dining.name: Dogs N Taters
dining.description: This quick-serve dining location serves two perennial favorites: Dollywood's fantastic foot-long dogs and signature curly fries. Stop by for a quick bite before catching a show at the Back Porch Theater just across the midway.

dining.name: Lakeside Lemonade
dining.description: Refreshing frozen and hand-squeezed lemonade served lakeside in Rivertown Junction — the perfect cool-down on a warm Smoky Mountain day.

dining.name: Market Square BIG SKILLET®
dining.description: As you make your way from Showstreet to Rivertown Junction, there's no denying the incredible aroma wafting from the open-air Market Square, featuring BIG SKILLET® crafted dishes.

dining.name: Potato Tornado
dining.description: Discover our spiral-cut spud that has become a Dollywood flavor sensation — the Potato Tornado! Great potato taste with a twist, served on a skewer to make it the perfect on-the-go taste.

dining.name: Jukebox Junction Dippin' Dots
dining.description: Dippin' Dots flash-frozen ice cream in Jukebox Junction. Try cookies n' cream, rainbow ice, or the seasonal festival flavor.

dining.name: Pines Theater Concessions
dining.description: Concessions serving snacks and beverages at the Pines Theater in Jukebox Junction — perfect for enjoying during a show.

dining.name: Red's Drive-In
dining.description: Menu classics from the '50s like burgers and fries are today's favorites at Red's Drive-In.

dining.name: Ned's Refresh Station
dining.description: Dollywood's resident adventurer Ned Oakley has a mountainous selection of snacks and drinks to get you refreshed and back on the search for Big Bear. Cotton candy, popcorn, an ICEE® and other refreshing beverages.

dining.name: Runway Refreshments
dining.description: Fuel up for your great adventure on NightFlight Expedition with tasty snacks. Enjoy pretzels, a variety of cold drinks and popcorn, including the one-of-a-kind souvenir bioluminator popcorn bucket designed by Cora and Jasper!

dining.name: Sweets and Treats
dining.description: Sweets and Treats has both savory and sweet options to fill up your family. Try a hot dog, butterfly pretzel, nachos, soft serve ice cream, churro fries or a refreshing beverage.

dining.name: Till & Harvest Food Hall
dining.description: Savor a variety of flavors at this scrumptious eatery featuring classic American dishes.

dining.name: Wildwood Grove Dippin' Dots
dining.description: Dippin' Dots flash-frozen ice cream in Wildwood Grove. Try cookies n' cream, rainbow ice, or the seasonal festival flavor.

dining.name: Dippin' Dots®
dining.description: The refreshing and unbeatable flash-frozen ice cream sensation, Dippin' Dots, is a true taste adventure. Flavor choices include cookies n' cream, rainbow ice, Big Bear brownie batter and cookie monster. Available at multiple locations throughout the park.

dining.name: Park Ranger's Canteen
dining.description: Having fun can make you hungry, and Park Ranger's Canteen offers a variety of popcorn snacks sure to satisfy, including build-your-own popcorn creations with a variety of toppings and sauces!

shops.name: The Dollywood Emporium
shops.description: The ultimate Dollywood shopping experience, featuring the best of all that Dollywood's many unique shops have to offer. You'll find a large selection of apparel, hats, accessories, gifts and souvenirs for the entire family, plus tasty fudge, savory treats and Dollywood's specialty jams, jellies and butters.

shops.name: Gazebo Gifts
shops.description: Whether you're shopping for gifts, light up toys or hats, this charming gazebo is filled with the latest Dollywood souvenirs so you can take home a memento of your Smoky Mountain visit.

shops.name: Sweet Shoppe Candy Kitchen
shops.description: A sweet stop on Showstreet featuring hand-crafted candies, fudge, and confections made fresh in the Smoky Mountain tradition.

shops.name: The Southern Pantry
shops.description: At Southern Pantry you'll find specialty items to add something extra to your next big meal or dinner party, with a wide selection of canned vegetables and fruits, dressings and more — plus decorative items to give your kitchen that special Southern flair.

shops.name: Traditions
shops.description: Dollywood's Traditions store offers southern-inspired goods and fashion, including brands like Simply Southern® and Kerusso®, plus much more.

shops.name: Wired Up Names
shops.description: Looking for a unique gift to commemorate your visit to Dollywood? Wired Up Names offers beautiful necklaces featuring your name spelled out using wire twisted into shape by a talented jewelry maker.

shops.name: The Mine Shaft
shops.description: When your travels take you through Timber Canyon, visit the Mine Shaft and browse our large selection of Dollywood shirts, hats, accessories, jewelry and personalized leather bracelets.

shops.name: Wired Up Names
shops.description: Looking for a unique gift to commemorate your visit to Dollywood? Wired Up Names offers beautiful necklaces featuring your name spelled out using wire twisted into shape by a talented jewelry maker.

shops.name: Eagle's Flight Outfitters
shops.description: Eagle's Flight Outfitters is soaring with great Wild Eagle merchandise, celebrating America's first wing coaster.

shops.name: Volunteer Supply
shops.description: Dollywood's Volunteer Supply company offers a great selection of FireChaser Express and Lucky the Dalmatian merchandise including t-shirts, toys and gifts. An array of jewelry and sunglasses are also available.

shops.name: Airbrush T-Shirts
shops.description: Create a personalized, custom airbrush T-shirt or other souvenir to take home as a one-of-a-kind reminder of your Dollywood visit.

shops.name: Caricatures & Portraits
shops.description: Talented artists preserve the memories of your special trip to Dollywood through creative caricatures and picture-perfect portraits and silhouettes. These capable artists also create an amazing array of fantastic face paintings to delight every kid in your group.

shops.name: Cozy Bear
shops.description: Stroll through the best one-stop-shop for all things play! Find plush toys, games and so much more.

shops.name: Hat Shop
shops.description: Step inside our shop to find a selection of handmade, quality hats.

shops.name: Hillside General Store
shops.description: It's a step back in time with a wonderful selection of old-fashioned goods and treasures that remind you of your favorite five and dime store. Relax on the porch playing checkers or let the folks back home know you're enjoying the Smokies with a postcard postmarked "Dollywood."

shops.name: Lucky 7 Mine & Pick-A-Pearl
shops.description: Shop amid hundreds of natural rocks and minerals, or find your own treasures when you mine from our working sluice box. Stop by the "Pick-A-Pearl" station, hand-pick your own oyster, and watch as one of our hosts helps you discover the beautiful pearl found inside.

shops.name: Old Flames Candles
shops.description: Long before electricity found its way deep into the hollows of the Great Smoky Mountains, dining by candlelight was a necessity. Today, our candle crafters make an array of beautiful and useful candles by hand, including cut and curl candles, taper candles and uniquely themed designs.

shops.name: Smoky Creek Leather
shops.description: Keeping with Smoky Mountain tradition, Dollywood's craftsmen still use hand-tooled leather to make a variety of belts in all sizes, each with a lifetime guarantee. Browse handcrafted leather belts, key chains, bracelets and barrettes or have unique ideas brought to life.

shops.name: Smoky Mountain Christmas Shop
shops.description: Explore our year-round Christmas shop featuring a variety of handmade and hand-painted ornaments, decorations and more. Valley Wood Carvers also finds its home here with amazing hand-crafted fireplace mantles and wooden figures.

shops.name: Valley Crafts
shops.description: Guests will be charmed, uplifted and inspired by the variety of custom-made art that brings the spirit of the Smokies to life. From faith-based artwork to hand painted signs featuring custom monograms to unique gifts and accessories.

shops.name: Valley Herbs and Remedies
shops.description: A charming shop celebrating Appalachian herbal traditions, offering a selection of natural herbs, teas, and homeopathic remedies inspired by Smoky Mountain mountain culture.

shops.name: Valley Forge Blacksmith
shops.description: Watch as Dollywood's master craftsmen use traditional ironsmith skills to forge hand-forged steel items including collector knives, customized metal gifts, horseshoe gifts, and garden and home decor.

shops.name: Grist Mill & Cinnamon Bread
shops.description: Pick up fresh-baked Dollywood favorites, unique food gifts, and Smoky Mountain-inspired treats at the Grist Mill shop.

shops.name: Temple's Warehouse and Old Fashioned Candy Store
shops.description: Temple's Warehouse pays homage to a longtime Pigeon Forge-area mercantile. Today, it serves as Dollywood's one-stop shop for the entire family featuring trains, toys, clothing and candy. Kids can even stuff their own bear to take home!

shops.name: Butterfly Strings Music Store
shops.description: Step inside this store, a tribute to Dolly's influence on country music, where you'll find a selection of apparel, gifts and more.

shops.name: Dollywood Crafters
shops.description: A showcase of locally inspired handcrafted goods and artisan wares, celebrating the craft traditions of the Great Smoky Mountains.

shops.name: Mountain Blown Glass
shops.description: Watch the glass blower breathe life into unique pieces including serving pitchers, vases, lamps and figurines. Let our craftsman help you create your own glass ornament as a keepsake to last a lifetime.

shops.name: Mountain Laurel Home
shops.description: Mountain Laurel Home celebrates the elegant splendor and warm simplicity of life in the Great Smoky Mountains. With unique home furnishings, candles, linens, soaps and many memory-capturing gifts, the collection is anchored in the quality and warmth of the mountains.

shops.name: Hi-Octane Ride Souvenirs
shops.description: Put the pedal to the metal and head over to Hi-Octane to pick up speedy souvenirs celebrating Lightning Rod. Select from a wide variety of Lightning Rod- and automotive-themed items including t-shirts, hats and die-cast hot rods.

shops.name: Dolly's Fan Shop
shops.description: From vintage to modern styles and everything in between, this merchandise boutique is all things Dolly!

shops.name: Hidden Hollow Outfitters
shops.description: Gear up for your Wildwood Grove adventure at Hidden Hollow Outfitters, featuring apparel, accessories and souvenirs inspired by the grove.

shops.name: Mountain Grove Merchants
shops.description: If you're looking to take a little bit of Wildwood Grove back home with you, Mountain Grove Merchants is your one-stop-shop for gifts and souvenirs celebrating your family's adventure in the grove.

crafts.name: Handsville Wax Company
crafts.description: Enjoy a hands-on, interactive experience with Handsville Wax Company! This unique shop gives you the opportunity to dip your hands into wax, creating a mold that captures a moment in time during your Dollywood visit. These molds capture incredible detail of your hands and jewelry — a fun keepsake and memory you'll have forever!

crafts.name: Old Flames Candles
crafts.description: Our third generation of candle crafters make an array of beautiful and useful candles by hand. Our craft shop also offers various types of candles including homemade cut and curl candles, hard to find taper candles and a large selection of uniquely themed candles. All ages enjoy the chance to dip their own candles in various colors of wax to create special family keepsakes.

crafts.name: Smoky Creek Leather
crafts.description: Living and working in the rugged Smoky Mountain terrain historically required durable leather items. Keeping with that tradition, Dollywood's craftsmen still use hand-tooled leather to make a variety of belts in all sizes, each with a lifetime guarantee.

crafts.name: Valley Forge Blacksmith
crafts.description: Hundreds of years ago, folks who settled in the Smoky Mountains relied on the skills of the area ironsmith for life's necessities. Today, Dollywood's master craftsmen use those same skills to forge hand-forged steel items. Watch as they create collector knives, customized metal gifts, horseshoe gifts, and garden and home decor.

crafts.name: Grist Mill & Cinnamon Bread
crafts.description: Built in 1982, the Dollywood Grist Mill was the first fully operational grist mill built in Tennessee in more than 100 years. Today, the Grist Mill is home to world-famous cinnamon bread, freshly made daily before your very eyes. Try it with buttercream icing or Dollywood's own apple butter.

crafts.name: Mountain Blown Glass
crafts.description: The timeless art of hand blown glass is demonstrated daily at Dollywood. Watch the glass blower breathe life into unique pieces, or let our craftsman help you create your own glass ornament as a keepsake to last a lifetime.
